review.title: Review before installing
review.intro: {name} contains actions that can run programs, type text or contact websites. Only install it if you trust the author.
review.sandboxed: Community effects always run sandboxed: no network, no files, no access to the rest of the app.
review.safe: This item only contains lighting, layouts or settings. Nothing runs on your PC.
review.disabledUntilEnabled: Installed keymap packs stay disabled until you turn them on.

import.title: Import
import.placeholder: Paste a gist link, a raw .json/.js URL, a keyhalo:// link or the JSON itself

share.title: Share
share.gistDone: Gist created. Anyone with KeyHalo can open it with this link.
share.publishIntro: KeyHalo opens a pull request on GitHub with your item. Maintainers review it and, once merged, it appears in everyone's gallery.

auth.why: Signing in lets you publish to the gallery and share gists. KeyHalo asks for the public_repo and gist scopes only.
auth.deviceSteps: Open {url} and enter the code below. This window updates automatically.
auth.useToken: Use a personal access token instead
auth.tokenHelp: Create a classic token with the public_repo and gist scopes (fine-grained tokens can create gists but may not be able to open pull requests on repositories you don't own).
auth.storedLocally: Your token is stored only on this PC, in KeyHalo's settings file. Sign out to remove it.

report.requestIntro: KeyHalo doesn't know this device yet. Open a request with its USB IDs, or describe it with the Device Wizard.

errors.network: Couldn't connect to GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. The gallery will refresh when you're back online.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again in about {minutes} min, or sign in to get a higher limit.
errors.unauthorized: GitHub rejected your sign-in. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: GitHub denied the request. Your token may be missing the public_repo or gist scope.
errors.notFound: That item couldn't be found. It may have been renamed or removed.
errors.invalidContent: This file isn't valid KeyHalo content: {problems}
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to import.
errors.unknownKind: KeyHalo couldn't tell what this file is (profile, keymap pack, effect, device or typing pack).
errors.needsConfirmation: This item has {count} action(s) that need your review before installing.
errors.noClientId: GitHub sign-in isn't configured in this build. Use a personal access token instead.
errors.deviceFlowUnavailable: GitHub sign-in with a code only works in the desktop app. In the browser demo, use a personal access token.
errors.authExpired: The sign-in code expired. Start again.
errors.forkTimeout: GitHub is taking too long to create your fork. Try again in a minute.
errors.invalidInput: That doesn't look like a gist, a link or KeyHalo JSON.

page.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

nothingToPublish.effect: No community effects are loaded. Install one or add your own in Lighting.
nothingToPublish.device: No device definitions yet. Use the Device wizard to describe your keyboard or mouse.

wizard.title: Add your keyboard or mouse
wizard.desc: Missing your device? The wizard reads its USB IDs, lights each LED so you can click the matching key, and builds a definition you can share with everyone in a pull request. No firmware is touched.
wizard.step1Text: Pick the device from the list of USB HID interfaces. KeyHalo reads its vendor and product IDs.
wizard.step2Text: KeyHalo lights one LED at a time; click the key that glows. Start from a layout template to go faster.
wizard.step3Text: Save the definition, test it, and publish it to the gallery so others with the same device get support.
wizard.connectedHint: Tell maintainers a definition works on your hardware: it helps promote it to Verified.

statusHelp.verified: Tested by maintainers on real hardware.
statusHelp.experimental: Built from protocol research; not confirmed yet. Your report helps.

wizard.request: Request support for a new device
